# ChartFrame

The shared anatomy every SongNodes chart is built from: thin–bold title, subtitle with unit and period, direct labels or a legend row, quiet axes, a tooltip on…

`SongNodes.ChartFrame` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ChartFrame title="…" subtitle="…" kind="line" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ChartFrame" title="…" subtitle="…" kind="line"></x-import>
```

## Props (ChartFrameProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lead` | `string` | Dimmed lead-in of the thin–bold title, without the colon ("Library"). |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold title in sentence case ("Plays per week by pillar"). |
| `subtitle` * | `string` | Unit, period and source ("Radio plays · 12 weeks, 3 Aug – 24 Oct 2026"). |
| `kind` * | `"line" \| "bar"` | Chart form. |
| `categories` * | `string[]` | X categories, already formatted ("3 Aug", "124–126"). |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` | Series to draw; more than 3 switches from direct labels to a legend row. |
| `yDomain` | `[number, number]` | Fixed y domain; default 0 to a nice max. |
| `reference` | `{ value: number; label: string }` | Labelled dashed reference line. |
| `nowAt` | `number` | Fractional x index of "now" (vertical --now line + "Now" tag). |
| `previewFrom` | `number` | First x index of simulated/projected data; drawn hatched and labelled "Preview". |
| `summary` * | `string` | One-sentence takeaway used as the SVG description for screen readers. |
| `emphasise` | `number` | Index of the bar or point that gets a direct value label. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Show the loading skeleton (keeps the frame size). |
| `empty` | `{ title: string; help: string; actionLabel?: string; onAction?: () => void }` | Empty-state copy and its one action; shown when every value is null or 0. |
| `tableCaption` * | `string` | Caption and column header for the "View as table" alternative. |
| `note` | `string` | Optional source / time zone note under the chart. |

### ChartSeries

One data series in a chart.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id; the colour slot follows the entity across filters. |
| `name` * | `string` | Visible name used for direct labels, legend and tooltip ("House"). |
| `slot` * | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Categorical slot 1–8 → `var(--chart-N)`. |
| `values` * | `Array<number \| null>` | Values aligned to the chart's x categories; null = no data. |
| `shape` | `"circle" \| "square" \| "diamond"` | Marker shape at the end point, second cue besides colour. |
